phase: after first dispatch, before its completion or cost inspection
decision: Do not dispatch another case if the completed run estimate exceeds USD 0.50, observed cumulative estimate reaches USD 2, or either billed phase has uninspectable usage.
enforcement: Coordinator checks between sequential runs. These are stop thresholds, not hard invoice caps. Each already-started run retains the unchanged workflow agent/detector credit limits and can overshoot these stop thresholds.
